name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible bug in Agent Bridge
title: "[bug]: "
labels: bug
---

## Environment

- **OS:** (e.g., Windows 11, macOS 15, Ubuntu 24.04)
- **Version:** (`agent-bridge --version`)
- **Mode:** (`agent-bridge-desktop-app` unified or attached / `stdio` / `start` / `serve` / `gemini serve` / `gemini project-read` / `gemini workstation` / `ui`)
- **Client:** (e.g., ChatGPT Web, Gemini Web, Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor)

## Description

A clear, concise description of the bug.

## Steps to Reproduce

1. Command / MCP tool call invoked
2. Expected behavior
3. Actual behavior / exact error code

> **Note:** For security vulnerabilities, please do **not** open a public issue. Use GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting instead (see `SECURITY.md`).
